summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. (the predecessor to American Battery Materials, Inc.) covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2019. Relevant to the task: The document contains Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows reporting a net decrease in cash of $63,078 for 2019. As this data predates the requested 2020–2024 trend period, it contributes no figures to the specific cash flow trend calculation required.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. (formerly U-Vend Inc.) covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2020. Relevant to the task: The document contains Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows reporting a net increase in cash of $23,586 for the year ended December 31, 2020. As other documents in the collection establish that BoxScore Brands, Inc. changed its name to American Battery Materials, Inc. in October 2022, this filing supplies the 2020 cash flow figure required for the trend analysis. It does not contain financial data for the years 2021 through 2024, so it cannot independently determine the complete trend.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. (predecessor to American Battery Materials, Inc.) covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: This document contains the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for both 2020 and 2021, reporting a net cash increase of $23,586 for 2020 and a net decrease of $15,295 for 2021. While it provides the foundational data for the initial two years of the requested 2020–2024 trend for American Battery Materials, Inc., it does not contain financial information for the years 2022, 2023, or 2024.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: The registrant explicitly documents a name change to "American Battery Materials, Inc." effective October 20, 2022, establishing it as the same entity queried in the task. The Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (Page F-6) report a net cash increase of $34,291 for 2022 and a net decrease of $15,295 for 2021. This document provides the primary source data for the 2022 cash flow figure within the requested trend period, though it does not contain data for 2020, 2023, or 2024.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for American Battery Materials, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: This document provides the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for the years ended December 31, 2023, and December 31, 2022, reporting a net decrease in cash of $35,206 for 2023 and a net increase of $34,291 for 2022. It confirms the company's identity as American Battery Materials, Inc. following the 2022 name change, linking to prior BoxScore Brands data. However, it does not contain financial data for 2020, 2021, or the full fiscal year 2024.
